original_value: This study examines how seasonal sound installations in community orchards reshape local navigation habits, memory mapping, and visitor pacing. Using interviews, acoustic sketches, and site observation, the paper proposes a framework for interpreting landscape design as a civic listening practice rather than a mobility optimization problem.
